newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduran president to visit Japan and South Korea.
newsitem.headline: Honduran president to visit Japan and South Korea.

text.p: Honduran President Carlos Roberto Reina plans to seek aid or loans for development projects during visits to Japan and South Korea next week, officials said on Thursday.
Reina, 70, left on Thursday for the first visits by a Honduran president to the two Asian countries.
During two days in Japan starting on Sunday, Reina has interviews scheduled with Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto and Emperor Akihito, foreign ministry sources said.
Officials said Reina would seek Japanese aid for a $20 million expansion of the Tegucigalpa airport and for a flood-control project in northern Honduras.

Reina is scheduled to arrive in Seoul next Wednesday for two days of meetings with government officials and business leaders. While in South Korea, he will seek $17 million in loans for hospital and electricty projects, the foreign ministry said.
